name: agent-calendar
description: Agent Calendar monorepo for the Electron desktop app, macOS widgets, and the backend they use.

scripts.test: npm --workspace apps/backend run test && npm --workspace apps/desktop run test && npm --workspace apps/runner run test
scripts.build:widget:unsigned: set -eu; derived_data_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agent-calendar-widget-derived-data.XXXXXX")"; cleanup() { rm -rf "$derived_data_dir"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; xcodebuild clean build -project apps/widget/macos/HermesWidgetHost/HermesWidgetHost.xcodeproj -scheme HermesWidgetHost -configuration Release -derivedDataPath "$derived_data_dir" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO; cleanup; trap - EXIT; test ! -e "$derived_data_dir"
scripts.verify:beta: npm run backend:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:desktop
